title: CHERNOBYL HEROES
en: They were told it was an ordinary roof fire. It was not.
April 26th, 1:30 a.m. The firefighters reached Chernobyl.
No protective suits. No radiation meters.
They were walking on radioactive debris beside an open reactor.
Within hours the vomiting began. Their skin started to burn.
They were flown to Hospital No. 6 in Moscow.
The doctors tried everything, but the radiation was far too high.
Within weeks, many of them had died.
They were buried in zinc coffins at Mitino Cemetery.
They gave their lives to save millions.
